title: DATASCOUT pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline for fetching protein and sequence data from multiple databases: ENA, UniProt, OrthoDB, and RFAM

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

samplesheet.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples and genomes.
samplesheet.help_text: You will need to create a samplesheet with information about the samples you would like to analyse before running the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

database_options.title: Database options
database_options.description: Options for database paths and configurations

taxdump.description: Path to NCBI taxonomy dump file
taxdump.help_text: Path to the NCBI taxonomy dump file used for taxonomic lineage parsing

sqlite.help_text: Path to NCBI sqlite database used for taxonomic lineage parsing

orthodb_db.description: Path to an existing OrthoDB database
orthodb_db.help_text: OrthoDB protein sequences are read from this database rather than downloaded one cluster at a time from the OrthoDB API. When left empty the pipeline builds one with ORTHODB_GETDB, which downloads about 39 GB of the OrthoDB data dump.

orthodb_db_dir.description: Where ORTHODB_GETDB keeps the OrthoDB database it builds
orthodb_db_dir.help_text: Only used when orthodb_db is empty. The database is built once and kept here, so later runs reuse it instead of downloading the data dump again.

orthodb_version.description: OrthoDB version ORTHODB_GETDB downloads the data dump from
orthodb_version.help_text: As it appears in the data.orthodb.org path, for example v12 or current. Only used when orthodb_db is empty.

orthodb_og2genes.description: Path to the OG2genes file of an OrthoDB data dump already on disk
orthodb_og2genes.help_text: Only used when orthodb_db is empty. Given together with the other dump file, ORTHODB_GETDB builds from them instead of downloading.

orthodb_og_aa_fasta.description: Path to the og_aa_fasta file of an OrthoDB data dump already on disk
orthodb_og_aa_fasta.help_text: Only used when orthodb_db is empty. Given together with the other dump file, ORTHODB_GETDB builds from them instead of downloading.

rfam_db.help_text: Path to the RFAM database file for RNA family searches. Defaults to bundled database in assets/

processing_options.title: Processing options
processing_options.description: Options for controlling pipeline processing behavior

max_runs.description: Maximum number of runs to process
max_runs.help_text: Limits the number of sequencing runs that will be downloaded and processed

download_rna_fastq.description: Enable transcriptomic FASTQ download and publishing
download_rna_fastq.help_text: Used only when sourmash is disabled. If sourmash is enabled, this flag is ignored.

sourmash.help_text: When enabled, uses sourmash for sequence similarity filtering instead of direct FASTQ download

swissprot.help_text: When enabled, restricts UniProt searches to SwissProt (manually curated) entries only

max_orthodb_clusters.description: Limit the number of OrthoDB clusters to fetch (mainly for testing)
max_orthodb_clusters.help_text: When set, limits the number of OrthoDB clusters fetched per sample. Useful for testing.

order_runs_by_smallest.description: Order fastq files from smallest to largest size when selecting transcriptome data
order_runs_by_smallest.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline will prioritize smaller fastq files when selecting transcriptome data from ENA. Useful for testing

orthodb_min_proteins.description: Minimum number of OrthoDB proteins required to keep a genome
orthodb_min_proteins.help_text: Samples whose combined_orthodb_<taxid>.faa holds fewer proteins than this are dropped: no orthodb_dir is produced and a row is written to low_protein_genomes.csv. 0 disables the filter.

skip_rfam.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline will not query RFAM for RNA family accessions, making this step optional
